title: norways princess astrid dies aged 94 two days after kings funeral 2026 09 11
text:
OSLO, Sept 11 (Reuters) - Norway's Princess Astrid, an ​older sister of the late ‌King Harald, died on Friday at ​the age of ​94, the royal palace ⁠said in a ​statement.
Astrid's brother Harald ​died last month, aged 89, after more than ​35 years on ​the throne, and the princess ‌made ⁠her last public appearance at his funeral on Wednesday.
"Throughout her ​long ​life, ⁠Princess Astrid represented the Royal ​House in ​a ⁠warm and dutiful manner," King Haakon VIII ⁠said ​in the ​statement.
